topics.title: Three new states in one month: November 2000

demand.title: How Punjab was Divided

topics.hook: एक ही महीने में भारत के तीन नए स्टेट कैसे बने?
topics.angle: In November 2000 three laws redrew the map in 15 days: Chhattisgarh out of Madhya Pradesh on 1 November, Uttaranchal (renamed Uttarakhand in 2007) out of Uttar Pradesh on 9 November as the 27th state, Jharkhand out of Bihar on 15 November. The split line device, three times.

topics.title: How Nagaland became India's 16th state on 1 December 1963

demand.title: How Punjab was Divided

topics.hook: नागालैंड पहले किस स्टेट का हिस्सा था?
topics.angle: Nagaland was the Naga Hills district of Assam until 1957; the State of Nagaland Act 1962 made it a state, inaugurated on 1 December 1963 as the 16th state with Kohima as capital, and its first elected assembly met in February 1964. The map lifts it out of Assam. Dated history only: no insurgency, no sides.
topics.why_now: Nagaland Statehood Day is 1 December 2026 (63rd anniversary), the same day the Hornbill Festival opens.
